box.highlights: Northport 55, Half Hollow Hills East 21: Simon Blissett found Carson Ciaio for a 76-yard touchdown through the air, kickstarting Northport's win at Half Hollow Hills East in Suffolk II. Greyson Cabrera followed with a 28-yard interception return for a score and later added a 55-yard pick six, as well as a 53-yard receiving touchdown from Blissett. Blissett finished with 245 passing yards and four touchdowns, throwing 34 and 51-yard scores to Daniel Miller. Tommy Zarcone scored on a 65-yard fumble recovery for the Tigers (2-0). Daniel White scored a three-yard rushing touchdown for Half Hollow Hills East (0-2).

Half Hollow Hills East 57, Newfield 7: Nick Sevilla completed 6 of 8 passes for 250 yards and three touchdowns and Daniel White rushed for 130 yards and two touchdowns and had 60 receiving yards as Half Hollow Hills East (1-2) defeated host Newfield (1-2) in Suffolk II. Akio Johnson has 12 tackles, a sack, and a 20-yard interception return for a touchdown. Michai Crump had eight tackles and Ryan Soto had six tackles, five pass break-ups and a 54-yard touchdown reception. RJ Peters had touchdown receptions of 59 and 62 yards.

Half Hollow Hills East 40, Connetquot 19: Jayden Bryan rushed for 100 yards and 4 TDs and added 5 tackles to lead traveling Half Hollow Hills East (2-2) in Suffolk II. Daniel White rushed for 160 yards and 1 TD.  Akio Johnson had 8 tackles and 1 sack, Dante Milano had 7 tackles, and Alex Floropolus had 4 tackles and 1 sack. Damian Sosa had a 75-yard fumble return for Connetquot (1-3).

Half Hollow Hills East 23, Bellport 13: Daniel White rushed for 103 yards and two touchdowns to lead Half Hollow Hills East (3-2) in Suffolk II. Jayden Bryan ran for 152 yards and another touchdown. On defense, Gianpierro Nicolia made 12 tackles, forced a fumble and recovered a fumble. Jake Pagliaro contributed eight tackles in the win. Noah Reinstein made a 25-yard field goal and both of his extra points. For Bellport (3-2), Braydon Cipp and Aiden Kerr each rushed for a touchdown.
Half Hollow Hills East 28, East Islip 7: Half Hollow Hills East defeats East Islip in Suffolk II.

Half Hollow Hills East 35, North Babylon 21: Daniel White rushed for 125 yards and 2 TDs and Vincent Banculli completed 3 for 4 passes for a TD and added nine tackles, 1 INT and 1 FF to lead host Half Hollow Hills East (5-2) in Suffolk II. Jaiden Bryan rushed for 115 yards and added 5 tackles, Akio Johnson had 12 tackles, 1 FR and 1 INT, Michai Crump had 15 tackles and Gianluca Dmacio had 10 tackles. Tristan Garcia threw a 16-yard TD pass to Jason Mack for North Babylon (3-4).

Half Hollow Hills East 43, Commack 0: Jaiden Bryan rushed for 194 yards on 10 carries and 3 TDs to lead visiting Half Hollow Hills East (6-2) in Suffolk II. Daniel White rushed for 200 yards on 13 carries and 2 TDs, and Tony Keahey had a rushing TD. Dante Milano and Akio Johnson each had 6 tackles.

Half Hollow Hills East 59, Smithtown East 28: Daniel White rushed for 201 yards and two touchdowns and returned a kickoff 90 yards for a TD to lead No. 2 Half Hollow Hills East over No. 7 Smithtown East in the quarterfinals of the Suffolk Division II football playoffs. White had 401 all-purpose yards. Jayden Bryan ran for 210 yards and three TDs and added three tackles. Dante Milano had 10 tackles and two sacks and Alex Floropolus had five tackles and 1 sack. Antonio Marrone had 22 rushes for 114 yards and a TD and threw for 274 yards and two TDs for Smithtown East (5-4). Jonathan Jean caught four passes for 136 yards and two scores.

No. 2 Half Hollow Hills East defeats No. 3 Huntington in the Suffolk Division II semifinals. The RedHawks will face top-seeded East Islip in the final at 6 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 22 at Stony Brook University.

East Islip 24, Half Hollow Hills East 17: No. 1 East Islip defeated No. 2 Half Hollow Hills East (8-3) in the Suffolk Division II championship game at Stony Brook University. This is the tenth Suffolk title for East Islip and its third title in the last five years. Jake Simmons had 32 carries for 244 yards and 3 touchdowns for East Islip. East Islip (10-1) will face Nassau's Garden City in the Long Island Class II championship game Saturday at Stony Brook at noon.
